items.name: white sand
items.description: Pale, sharp-grained, gathered off the channel bank where the water sorts it for you.

items.name: resin
items.description: Tacky and slow. Smells like the forest does after rain.

items.name: iron scrap
items.description: A hand's length of flat bar. Someone cut it to size a very long time ago.

items.name: glass blank
items.description: A cooled disc, thick at the middle. Not yet anything.

items.name: reading lens
items.description: Ground to bring close things closer. Vesk grinds the edge flat so it sits on stone without rocking.

items.name: wide lens
items.description: Shallow and broad. Takes in more and shows it smaller.

items.name: burning lens
items.description: Gathers light to a point. Vesk lights the kiln with one on clear mornings, out of habit rather than need.

items.name: drowned lens
items.description: Older than Vesk's work and better made. It has been in the water long enough to grow a skin of green.

items.name: sunmoss
items.description: Grows on the shaded side and opens at dusk, which is the wrong way round and nobody knows why.

items.name: ledger slip
items.description: Orrel's handwriting. A record that something changed hands, which in this valley is as good as coin.

items.name: cut fuel
items.description: Split to a uniform length. Someone measured. Someone is still measuring.

clues.title: scorched bark, no fire
clues.text: The eastern trees are heat-marked halfway up the trunk. There is no burn on the ground beneath them. Whatever did this did not come from a fire anyone lit out here.

clues.title: the ash is kiln ash
clues.text: Vesk turned it over twice and got annoyed. It is kiln ash, not wood ash — and his kiln was stone cold the last Quietday. He can prove it. He wants to know who else is firing.

clues.title: the channel runs warm
clues.text: Coll mentioned it the way you mention that it is Tuesday. On Quietday mornings the water at the head gate is warm to the wrist. It has done that for as long as he has minded it.

clues.title: there is a second kiln
clues.text: Under the shelf, back in the cut stone, where the pool used to sit on top of it. It is not on any map anyone in Heartwood uses. It is not a ruin.

clues.title: someone is keeping it lit
clues.text: Fuel split to a uniform length, stacked dry. The floor swept. The fire banked the way you bank a fire you intend to come back to. This has been going on for a very long time, and it is not for you.
